copy_check_scope: All seven provided strings were visually matched at native and720px-wide views; the authorized main-claim linebreak is normalized to one space for string comparison. Raster appearance cannot prove Unicode codepoints, especially the en dash. No OCR used. Thumbnail view is not evidence of exact reading of every small line.

mandatory_conditions.evidence: One native imagegen call, referenced_image_paths contains only own repair-1/final.png; transparent_background false; no other reference mechanism. This is Round5D P02 second and FINAL correction2/2.
Native unchanged1122x1402, ratio0.8002853067047075;1122*5=5610 and1402*4=5608. No final crop, native resize or retouch.

Two lines at approximately x75–522,y167–355 read 가볍게 접고, / 다시 펼치다. Every white glyph, including the final 다 at x430–500,y278–352, lies over the dark upper-left background. The nearest pale hand/forearm contour is far to its right. The claim neither touches the arm boundary nor overlays skin; no outlines, shadows, halos or backing panel visible.

The bold two-line claim remains the largest text. Small FOLN/Fold Cup stays upper-left; lower information retains common left edge and role gaps. The wrapping occupies existing negative space rather than moving the photograph.

Compact dark forest-green no-handle silicone cup remains near x387–884,y481–756; nested rounded folds, same fitted milky translucent white lid, thumb on lid and supporting fingertips underneath, continuous bag opening, cloth weave, sleeve and photographic light/crop remain visually in same positions and roles. Direct native source/result comparison finds no obvious large scene movement. Pixel QA finds broad small changes, so exact photographic pixel preservation is not asserted.

White lid tracks the cup front/side ellipse; broad upper rim diameter remains coherent. Cup sits above dark bag mouth, with distinct thumb, fingertips, green folds and white rim edges. Far rim seating, palm-side grip and all hidden contact surfaces cannot be verified.

FOLN, Fold Cup, specification, release, preorder and URL remain exact-looking at native/720 and in the original upper-left/lower-left positions with the existing gaps. Pixel-level letter rendering is not identical after native edit.

Native surfaces of cup, lid, hand/sleeve and canvas inspected: no product letters, labels, logos, invented price/performance/certification, icons, fake microtype or watermark. Only the supplied seven strings appear.
350 mL is supplied specification; pixels do not establish actual volume, mechanics or manufacturing.
